verdict.rationale: Tilled documents a merchant-facing reporting console that Enterprise partners can white-label on their own domain. It also offers batch close via API to make reconciliation easier, and merchants have Dashboard access to related money items such as disputes and subscriptions. However, nothing shows per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, or bookkeeper-ready exports. missing for 10: per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, data exports (CSV/accounting), evidence that sellers can close the month self-serve, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, sellers can self-serve their money questions — per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, and exports that let their bookkeeper close the month without contacting me

citations.quote: Enterprise partners have the ability to host their API, merchant onboarding, and reporting console experiences on a domain that reflects their own identity
By closing a batch via API, a store can ensure their transactions are settled at time of close or end of shift to account for easier reconciliation or tip adjustments.
